    10  /-!
    11  # Co-finitely generated submodules
    12  
    13  This files defines the notion of a co-finitely generated submodule. A submodule `S` of a module
    14  `M` is co-finitely generated (or CoFG for short) if the quotient of `M` by `S` is finitely
    15  generated (i.e. FG).
    16  
    17  ## Main declarations
    18  
    19  - `Submodule.CoFG` expresses that a submodule is co-finitely generated.
    20  
    21  -/
    22  
    23  public section
    24  
    25  namespace Submodule
    26  
    27  section Ring
    28  
    29  variable {R : Type*} [Ring R]
    30  variable {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    31  
    32  /-- A submodule `S` of a module `M` is co-finitely generated (CoFG) if the quotient
    33    space `M ⧸ S` is finitely generated. -/
    34  abbrev CoFG (S : Submodule R M) : Prop := Module.Finite R (M ⧸ S)
    35  
    36  /-- A submodule of a finite module is CoFG. -/
    37  @[simp] theorem CoFG.of_finite [Module.Finite R M] {S : Submodule R M} : S.CoFG :=
    38    Module.Finite.quotient R S
    39  
    40  /-- The top submodule is CoFG. -/
    41  @[simp] theorem CoFG.top : (⊤ : Submodule R M).CoFG := inferInstance
    42  
    43  variable (R M) in
    44  /-- A module is finite if and only if the bottom submodule is CoFG. -/
    45  theorem _root_.Module.Finite.iff_cofg_bot : (⊥ : Submodule R M).CoFG ↔ Module.Finite R M :=
    46    ⟨fun _ => Module.Finite.equiv (quotEquivOfEqBot ⊥ rfl), fun _ => CoFG.of_finite⟩
    47  
    48  /-- A complement of a CoFG submodule is FG. -/
    49  theorem CoFG.fg_of_isCompl {S T : Submodule R M} (hST : IsCompl S T) (hS : S.CoFG) : T.FG :=
    50    Module.Finite.iff_fg.mp <| Module.Finite.equiv <| quotientEquivOfIsCompl S T hST
    51  
    52  /-- Over a noetherian ring, if `S` and `T` are disjoint and `T` is CoFG, then `S` is FG. -/
    53  theorem CoFG.fg_of_disjoint [IsNoetherianRing R] {S T : Submodule R M} (hST : Disjoint S T)
    54      (hT : T.CoFG) : S.FG :=
    55    .of_disjoint_of_isNoetherian_quotient hST
    56  
    57  /-- If `S` and `T` are co-disjoint and `S` is FG, then `T` is CoFG. -/
    58  theorem FG.cofg_of_codisjoint {S T : Submodule R M} (hST : Codisjoint S T) (hS : S.FG) :
    59      T.CoFG :=
    60    have := Module.Finite.iff_fg.mpr hS
    61    .of_surjective (T.mkQ.domRestrict S) (by simp [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, hST.symm.eq_top])
    62  
    63  /-- A complement of an FG submodule is CoFG. -/
    64  theorem FG.cofg_of_isCompl {S T : Submodule R M} (hST : IsCompl S T) (hS : S.FG) : T.CoFG :=
    65    hS.cofg_of_codisjoint hST.codisjoint
    66  
    67  /-- A submodule that contains a CoFG submodule is CoFG. -/
    68  theorem CoFG.of_le {S T : Submodule R M} (hT : S ≤ T) (hS : S.CoFG) : T.CoFG := by
    69    rw [← sup_eq_right.mpr hT]
    70    exact Module.Finite.equiv (quotientQuotientEquivQuotientSup S T)
